An AI assistant can now do much of the work a pharmacometrics (PMX) intern
did in 2020: writing model code, debugging it, drawing the plots, drafting
the report. An intern who uses the same assistant can also do more than a
2020 intern could, possibly with less of the mentor's time. This project asks
which of those wins, where the mentor's time still changes the outcome, and
writes down what the mentor and the intern should each expect before the
internship starts.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). The question, what has changed
  since 2020, where the mentor's time goes, the expectations on each side,
  how the intern's work is validated, how to tell whether a lighter-touch
  internship worked, and the open questions.
